recent.title: US CPI y/y (Sep)
recent.note: Core beat twice (0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y) — the October-hold thesis broke; December fully priced.

recent.title: US PPI m/m (Sep)
recent.note: Biggest jump since Mar 2022; core +0.7% — and the market faded October anyway (LSEG ~29%).

recent.title: US retail sales m/m (Sep)
recent.note: Gasoline (+7.1%) did the work — control group only +0.1% vs 0.3% fcst.

recent.title: US core retail sales m/m (Sep)
recent.note: Beat on the ex-autos measure; ex-gas-and-autos just +0.2%.

recent.title: Philly Fed manufacturing (Oct)
recent.note: Second straight decline (from 37.8) but still expanding — cooling factory pulse.

recent.title: Empire State manufacturing (Oct)
recent.note: Sharpest regional read in the current data set — new orders 23.2.

USD.note: Two hot wholesale prints in two days, and the market chose the risk-off tape — October faded anyway. Claims 199K inline.

recent.title: Eurozone industrial production m/m (Aug)
recent.note: July revised deeper to -0.3% — soft factory texture into the ECB's Oct 29.

recent.title: France final CPI m/m (Sep)
recent.note: Confirms the overshoot (HICP 3.4%, highest since Jan 2024) — no new signal.

recent.title: German WPI y/y (Sep)
recent.note: Hottest since Feb 2023 — a miss on the disinflation read, but it firms the ECB's December-hike case.

EUR.note: Soft factories + inline France CPI — the pair trades the dollar leg.

recent.title: UK GDP m/m (Aug)
recent.note: Growth holding, not stalling — the ~86% November BoE hike case carries on.

GBP.note: One growth beat — the BoE's hawkish hold keeps its domestic cover.

recent.title: Japan core machinery orders m/m (Aug)
recent.note: Broad capex rebound — the domestic-demand leg of the BoJ's December case.

recent.title: Japan industrial production m/m (Aug, rev)
recent.note: Second straight contraction, steepest since January — output is the soft leg.

JPY.note: Split — capex beats, output misses; the BoJ's Oct 29–30 forecasts decide which one matters.

recent.title: Swiss PPI m/m (Sep)
recent.note: Came in below the bar (better=lower) — disinflation intact; December SNB cut risk stays on the table.

CHF.note: Soft pipeline — the franc's story is the haven bid, not the print.

recent.title: Australia employment (Sep)
recent.note: Five-year-high unemployment above the RBA's 4.5% Q4 forecast — the November-hike case weakens.

recent.title: China exports y/y (Sep)
recent.note: AI-hardware export boom — demand signal, not a domestic breakout.

recent.title: China CPI y/y (Sep)
recent.note: Consumer demand still muted while factory-gate heat is oil-driven.

AUD.note: The jobs miss is the one that counts — slack building faster than the RBA's forecasts implied.

recent.title: Canada manufacturing sales m/m (Aug)
recent.note: Beat on prices — volumes flat; texture vs the -68.3K jobs shock (outside the window).

recent.title: Canada building permits m/m (Aug)
recent.note: Rebound led by multi-unit residential; stabilizing pipeline, not a BoC game-changer.

CAD.note: Goods-economy texture — the -68.3K jobs shock is still the BoC's main event.
